definitions.explanation: The systematic recording of financial transactions. A fundamental skill in business administration and one of the most popular professional certifications in Japan.

examples.japanese: {簿記|ぼき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{簿記|ぼき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm taking a bookkeeping class at university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{簿記|ぼき}{二級|にきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to take the Level 2 bookkeeping exam for my job search.

notes:
USAGE:
{簿記|ぼき} most often appears in the context of certifications and education. The {日商簿記|にっしょうぼき} (Nissho Bookkeeping) examination, administered by the Japan Chamber of Commerce, is one of the most widely taken professional certifications in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {簿記|ぼき}⟦{検定|けんてい}→検定：13131_kentei⟧: bookkeeping certification exam
- {簿記|ぼき}{二級|にきゅう}: Level 2 bookkeeping (most sought-after level)
- {複式|ふくしき}{簿記|ぼき}: double-entry bookkeeping
- {簿記|ぼき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧: knowledge of bookkeeping
- {簿記|ぼき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to study bookkeeping

ETYMOLOGY:
Thought to derive from the English word "bookkeeping" (via {簿|ぼ} meaning "register/ledger" and {記|き} meaning "record").
